products.name: Site Inspection Follow-Up
products.product: A corrective-action queue that connects cleaning inspection findings to owners, evidence, client updates, and verified resolution.
products.audience: owner-operated commercial cleaning and janitorial companies
products.problem: Inspection scores and photos are collected, but individual findings are not consistently assigned and verified before the next service cycle.
products.valueProposition: Turns each finding into a traceable corrective action with location context, due date, proof, and closure review.
products.topic: commercial cleaning inspection corrective action tracking
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets janitorial inspection checklist, cleaning quality corrective action, site audit template, and inspection follow-up software searches.

products.name: Location Supply Par Tracker
products.product: A simple replenishment workflow for chemicals, liners, paper goods, and consumables stored across client locations.
products.audience: owner-operated commercial cleaning and janitorial companies
products.problem: Supplies are reordered after crews report a shortage, while counts, storage locations, usage spikes, and delivery ownership remain inconsistent.
products.valueProposition: Uses location-level par levels, count evidence, reorder ownership, delivery confirmation, and exception review.
products.topic: janitorial supply inventory and location replenishment tracking
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets cleaning supply inventory spreadsheet, janitorial par level template, site supply checklist, and consumable reorder software searches.

products.name: Crew Shift Handoff Log
products.product: A location-specific shift record for exceptions, unfinished work, access issues, supply problems, and follow-up ownership.
products.audience: owner-operated commercial cleaning and janitorial companies
products.problem: Critical details are passed verbally or in group chat, so the next crew cannot distinguish a resolved issue from work that still needs attention.
products.valueProposition: Creates a short, searchable handoff with issue type, location, evidence, next action, owner, and acknowledgement.
products.topic: commercial cleaning shift handoff and crew communication logs
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets janitorial shift report template, cleaning crew handoff checklist, supervisor log book, and location communication app searches.
